notes_for_editor: Only Alberta's own open-data record and three Alberta pages were usable. Several searches found no history, fire, construction or public-access source for Petitot, so the story is short. The brief's built year (2012), 30 m height and 779.0 m elevation match the record; no corrections. The record marks the position as not verified (LOCATION_VERIFIED N), so the map point may be less precise than for the other two sites. Access is left out of facts: the brief's 'closed' level and its 'staffed March-October' and 'please don't visit uninvited' wording do not appear in any cached Alberta page and were not repeated. The Petitot River in northwestern Alberta shares the name; no source links the river to the lookout, so the story does not. The layer description (footnote 4) says the data is classed Protected and should not be shown on public maps larger than 1:1,000,000 or on maps with local roads; check the coordinates on Firefinder's map against that.
